title: Chapter 268: Value of Your Life
html:
Strange noises came from deep within the scenario, while the stench in the air had noticeably weakened. Are they evenly matched? These two society members must be powerful.

Chen Ge quickened his pace. Wei Wu was nowhere in sight; after being frightened, the unfortunate man had probably fled straight to the scenario’s deepest point.

Where can you run? This scenario is sealed and has only one exit.

The Ghost Stories Society had invaded his Haunted House during business hours, creating an intolerable threat. Unless he destroyed the society, its members would return. Chen Ge had no intention of holding back. Ten meters farther down the corridor, the battle came into view.

Kong Xiangming wore a grim expression. A thin monster stood upon his shoulders, longer and stronger than those from the Third Sick Hall—likely because it had consumed many innocent people. Nearly four meters long and covered in weeping faces, it resembled a grotesque centipede.

Opposing it was the mannequin with a rope around its neck. Though its body had suffered obvious damage, it charged again and again.

“The fiercer the soul, the better it tastes.”

Kong Xiangming regarded the mannequin with amusement. The monster on his shoulders barely acknowledged it, instead staring warily in another direction.

The stench filling the scenario had gathered into the shadowy form of a huge man. Though immensely strong, the figure’s blurred body moved too clumsily to fight effectively in the cramped corridor.

Neither the fat man nor the mannequin understood combat, and Kong Xiangming’s tactics made the contest one-sided. Their wounds multiplied, their bodies blurred, and the scenario’s stench gradually faded.

Are they really that weak?After a moment, Chen Ge understood. Zhang Ya had already consumed most of Western Jiujiang’s Private Academy’s powerful and defiant Baleful Specters. Only these two weaker spirits remained.

Wei Wu hid behind Kong Xiangming. The instant his blood face saw Chen Ge approaching, it screamed.

“Be careful! Our target is coming toward us!”

Kong Xiangming held the advantage, but he was already facing two opponents. Chen Ge’s arrival could overturn the battle.

“Why did you lead him here?” Kong Xiangming kept his voice calm, but the words came faster.

“I didn’t mean to! Switch with me. You handle him, and I’ll deal with these two.” Like the Pen Spirit, Wei Wu’s blood face possessed a specialized ability unsuited to direct combat. Kong Xiangming understood. “Fine.”

They had fought together before. Moving back to back, they exchanged positions. Blood vessels surged from Wei Wu’s skull, and the face slowly assumed the mannequin’s features. The moment the imitation was complete, the savage mannequin fell still and its eyes emptied.

Wei Wu had neutralized the mannequin but could do nothing against the fat man. He watched helplessly as the figure recovered and the stench returned. Leaving the specters to his companion, Kong Xiangming turned toward Chen Ge together with the thin monster on his back.

With Doctor Skull-cracker’s costume, a skin mask, and the hammer, Chen Ge made it difficult to decide which side was more terrifying. Kong Xiangming’s usual threats suddenly felt inappropriate. Compared with the ‘monster’ before him, he seemed almost normal.

“We can discuss this,” Kong Xiangming said smoothly. “Neither of us came out of malice. We were following orders.”

Chen Ge did not answer. Anyone who had survived so long in that deranged society could not be trusted. He raised the hammer. Kong Xiangming might have spoken the truth, but Chen Ge neither dared nor wished to gamble on it.

“Think before you attack. I know you have entered the world behind the door. I can reveal one of its secrets if you agree to a condition.” Sensing danger, Kong Xiangming spoke faster. “This is a rare opportunity. We can cooperate. One condition—that is my bottom line.”

“Bottom line?” Chen Ge took one step, then exploded forward. “You dare negotiate inside my Haunted House? You truly don’t understand how little your life is worth. Xu Yin!”

At Chen Ge’s call, a melancholy young man covered in wounds appeared beside him. Man and ghost charged Kong Xiangming together.

Kong Xiangming’s lips twitched as he recognized the problem. The thin monster could restrain Chen Ge’s specter, but who would stop the madman with the hammer?

“So painful!” Xu Yin landed, and blood poured from his reopened wounds. His face twisted with rage and resentment as he attacked the thin monster. It was stronger than Chen Ge had expected. The faces across its body wailed, slowing Xu Yin, while its arms closed around his neck and its many mouths tore at his clothes.

The faces temporarily restrained Xu Yin, but once the thin monster became entangled with him, nothing remained to protect Kong Xiangming.

Having fought similar creatures at the Third Sick Hall, Chen Ge knew their weakness. Once separated from its host, a thin monster lost at least thirty percent of its power. It had never been his true target.

“Wait a minute!”

The hammer tore through the air, draining Kong Xiangming’s face of color. In desperation, he ordered the thin monster to abandon Xu Yin and protect him. Understanding its host’s importance, the creature immediately released the ghost and moved to intercept the blow.

Freed, Xu Yin landed and attacked again, sinking his teeth ravenously into the thin monster’s neck. The more he consumed, the brighter the bloodstain on his shirt became.

The hammer struck the thin monster at the same moment. Chen Ge neither paused to assess the damage nor allowed Kong Xiangming another word. He rained blow after blow upon his opponent.

Kong Xiangming struggled to defend himself, while Wei Wu lost ground behind him. Though Wei Wu controlled the hanging man, he could do nothing against the fat man, whose body was steadily recovering.

“If we stay, we’ll both die. Good luck, Kong!” Wei Wu shouted. Abandoning the fight, he turned and sprinted past Kong Xiangming and Chen Ge.
